theorems.name: Radial limits of mock theta functions (Folsom-Ono-Rhoades)
theorems.name_zh: Mock theta 函数的径向极限 (Folsom-Ono-Rhoades)
theorems.applicable_when: 计算 mock theta function 在有理点处 y→0+ 的极限值，或涉及 q-series 在单位根处的径向极限
theorems.reduces: F(z) = f(q) 是 Ramanujan 三阶 mock theta function，G(z) = b(q) 是其 modular shadow（eta-quotient）。在偶数阶 2k 单位根 ζ 处，f(q) 和 b(q) 都有指数奇点，但 Folsom-Ono-Rhoades 定理给出精确有限差：lim_{q→ζ}(f(q) - (-1)^k b(q)) = -4ζ - 4·Σ_{n=1}^{k-1} (1+ζ)²(1+ζ²)²···(1+ζⁿ)²·ζ^{n+1}。由于 |b(q)| → ∞，F/G → (-1)^k，G/F → (-1)^k，所以 F/G - G/F → 0。因此 α = lim(F-G+F/G-G/F) = lim(F - (-1)^k G) + 0 = Folsom-Ono-Rhoades 常数（当 (-1)^k = 1 时）
prerequisites: identify the mock theta function type
the rational point h/k and denominator k
the associated shadow or modular completion
invariant_hints: F(z) = f(q) is Ramanujan's 3rd order mock theta; G(z) = b(q) is its modular shadow
G(z) = b(q) = prod(1-q^n)^3 / prod(1-q^{2n})^2 (eta-quotient, has exponential singularity at even-order roots of unity)
the rational point h/k: for z0 = ell_1/(4*ell_2), we have h = ell_1, k = 4*ell_2, and zeta = e^{2*pi*i*h/k}
the order of zeta as root of unity is k (when gcd(h,k)=1), so 2*k_half = k, k_half = k/2
Folsom-Ono-Rhoades formula: lim(f(q) - (-1)^{k_half} b(q)) = -4*zeta - 4*sum_{n=1}^{k_half-1} prod_{j=1}^{n}(1+zeta^j)^2 * zeta^{n+1}
since |b(q)| -> infinity exponentially, F/G -> (-1)^{k_half} and G/F -> (-1)^{k_half}, so F/G - G/F -> 0
therefore alpha = lim(F-G+F/G-G/F) = Folsom-Ono-Rhoades constant (a finite sum, no singularities)
verification_hints: verify the limit is algebraic by computing its minimal polynomial
cross-check: evaluate F and G numerically at y=0.1, 0.01 and check convergence trend
confirm the minimal polynomial is irreducible over Q
check degree of minimal polynomial divides phi(k) or related index
preferred_recipe: identify F(z) as a known mock theta function before doing any computation
extract the rational point h/k and work in CyclotomicField(k)
replace the radial limit by the finite roots-of-unity formula
compute alpha exactly before asking for minpoly()
avoid_patterns: do not numerically approximate the y -> 0+ radial limit by shrinking eps
do not truncate divergent q-series at floating-point q near a root of unity
do not spend multiple tool calls probing different eps values
theorems.sage_hint:
CRITICAL: Do NOT evaluate G(z)=b(q) directly at a root of unity (it has exponential singularity). Instead use the Folsom-Ono-Rhoades finite formula.
For z0 = ell_1/(4*ell_2), set k = 4*ell_2, h = ell_1, k_half = k//2.
zeta = e^{2*pi*i*h/k} is a primitive k-th root of unity.
Since |b(q)| -> infinity, F/G -> (-1)^k_half and G/F -> (-1)^k_half, so F/G - G/F -> 0.
Therefore alpha = lim(F - G + F/G - G/F) = lim(F - (-1)^k_half * G) (when (-1)^k_half = 1) = Folsom-Ono-Rhoades constant.
FORMULA: alpha = -4*zeta - 4*sum_{n=1}^{k_half-1} prod_{j=1}^{n}(1+zeta^j)^2 * zeta^{n+1}
SageMath code:
k = 4*ell_2; h = ell_1; k_half = k // 2
K.<z> = CyclotomicField(k)
zeta = z^h
alpha = -4*zeta - 4*sum(prod((1+zeta^j)^2 for j in range(1,n+1)) * zeta^(n+1) for n in range(1, k_half))
P = alpha.minpoly(); print('P =', P)
K_alpha = NumberField(P, 'a')
Gal = K_alpha.galois_closure('b')
deg = Gal.degree()
Omega = (P(ell_1) + P(ell_2))^(ell_2-1) / deg
print('Omega =', Omega)

theorems.name: Identification of common mock theta functions
theorems.name_zh: 常见 mock theta 函数的识别
theorems.applicable_when: 识别一个 q-series 是否为已知的 mock theta function
theorems.reduces: 一旦识别出 mock theta 类型，就可以调用对应的径向极限公式，而不需要从头推导
invariant_hints: Ramanujan 3rd order f(q) = sum_{n>=0} q^{n^2} / (-q;q)_n^2 = sum_{n>=0} q^{n^2} / prod_{j=1}^n (1+q^j)^2
Ramanujan 3rd order phi(q) = sum_{n>=0} q^{n^2} / (-q^2;q^2)_n
Ramanujan 3rd order psi(q) = sum_{n>=1} q^{n^2} / (q;q^2)_n
Ramanujan 3rd order chi(q) = sum_{n>=0} q^{n^2} (-q;q)_n
Ramanujan 3rd order omega(q) = sum_{n>=0} q^{2n(n+1)} / (q;q^2)_{n+1}^2
if F(z) = 1 + sum e^{2pi i n^2 z} / prod (1+e^{2pi i j z})^2, then F(z) = f(q) with q=e^{2pi i z}
verification_hints: verify by comparing first few q-expansion coefficients with known OEIS sequences
theorems.sage_hint: To verify identification: compute first 20 terms of the q-expansion symbolically and compare with known mock theta tables. For f(q): PowerSeriesRing(QQ,'q'); sum(q^(n^2)/prod((1+q^j)^2 for j in range(1,n+1)) for n in range(20)).

theorems.name: Eta-quotient evaluation at rational points
theorems.name_zh: Eta 商在有理点的取值
theorems.applicable_when: 计算 Dedekind eta 函数或 eta-quotient 在有理点/尖点处的值
theorems.reduces: eta-quotient 在有理点 h/k 处的值可以用 roots of unity 的有限乘积精确计算。关键：prod_{n=1}^{infinity} (1-zeta^n) 在 zeta 为 primitive k-th root of unity 时等于 k（当 zeta^k=1 时 prod_{n=1}^{k-1}(1-zeta^n) = k）
invariant_hints: eta(tau) = q^{1/24} prod_{n>=1} (1-q^n), q = e^{2pi i tau}
prod_{n=1}^{k-1} (1-zeta_k^n) = k for primitive k-th root zeta_k
G(z) = prod (1-q^n)(1-q^{2n-1})/(1+q^n) = eta(tau)^3 / eta(2*tau)^2 * q^{1/24} (up to q-power)
at rational point h/k: evaluate as finite product over n=1..k using zeta_k = exp(2*pi*I*h/k)
use CyclotomicField for exact computation
verification_hints: check: the product should stabilize (become periodic) after n=k terms
confirm consistency with modular transformation formulas
preferred_recipe: rewrite the product as an eta-quotient or periodic finite product at zeta_k
evaluate in CyclotomicField(k) instead of floating point
combine with the mock theta finite-sum expression only after both pieces are exact
avoid_patterns: do not evaluate the infinite product numerically near a root of unity
do not try many truncation lengths without switching to exact roots-of-unity arithmetic
theorems.sage_hint: K = CyclotomicField(k); zeta = K.gen(); G_val = prod((1-zeta^n)*(1-zeta^(2*n-1))/(1+zeta^n) for n in range(1, k+1)). Use exact cyclotomic arithmetic, NOT floating point.

theorems.name: Evaluation of modular forms at cusps / rational points
theorems.name_zh: 模形式在尖点/有理点处的取值
theorems.applicable_when: 计算模形式在有理数或尖点处的精确值
theorems.reduces: 模形式在尖点处的值由其 q-展开的有限项和 modular transformation 决定，可精确计算
invariant_hints: level N
weight k
character
cusp width
Atkin-Lehner eigenvalues
theorems.sage_hint: ModularForms(N, k); f.q_expansion(); or use modular symbols

theorems.name: Computational recipe for radial limits of q-series at roots of unity
theorems.name_zh: q-级数在单位根处径向极限的计算方法
theorems.applicable_when: 需要计算 q-series（mock theta 或 eta-quotient）在 q 趋向单位根时的极限
theorems.reduces: 把发散的无穷级数/乘积转化为有限的精确代数运算
invariant_hints: step 1: identify h and k from the rational point (e.g. ell_1/(4*ell_2) → h=ell_1, k=4*ell_2, k_half=k//2)
step 2: set zeta = CyclotomicField(k).gen()^h (exact primitive k-th root of unity)
step 3: recognize F(z)=f(q) and G(z)=b(q); both diverge at even-order roots of unity
step 4: apply Folsom-Ono-Rhoades: lim(f-(-1)^{k_half}*b) = -4*zeta - 4*sum_{n=1}^{k_half-1} prod_{j=1}^{n}(1+zeta^j)^2 * zeta^{n+1}
step 5: since |b(q)|->inf, F/G->(-1)^{k_half}, G/F->(-1)^{k_half}, so F/G-G/F->0
step 6: alpha = Folsom-Ono-Rhoades constant (finite sum, no singularities)
step 7: use minpoly() on alpha, then galois_closure() for splitting field degree
verification_hints: the result should be an algebraic number in CyclotomicField(k) or a subfield
minimal polynomial should have rational coefficients
degree of minimal polynomial divides euler_phi(k)
preferred_recipe: extract h and k first, then define zeta in CyclotomicField(k)
compute F_val and G_val as exact finite expressions before forming alpha
only after alpha is exact, call minpoly() and galois_closure()
avoid_patterns: do not alternate between many numerical experiments and symbolic experiments without committing to the exact roots-of-unity route
do not burn multiple tool calls on shrinking eps once a radial-limit theorem is matched
theorems.sage_hint:
FORMULA (Folsom-Ono-Rhoades Theorem 1.1):
For zeta = primitive 2k-th root of unity (i.e. order of zeta is 2k):
lim_{q->zeta}(f(q) - (-1)^k * b(q)) = -4*zeta - 4*sum_{n=1}^{k-1} prod_{j=1}^{n}(1+zeta^j)^2 * zeta^{n+1}
where f(q) = F(z) is the mock theta function and b(q) = G(z) is the modular shadow.
Since |b(q)| -> infinity exponentially, F/G -> (-1)^k and G/F -> (-1)^k, so F/G - G/F -> 0.
Therefore alpha = lim(F - G + F/G - G/F) = lim(F - (-1)^k G) + 0.
SageMath implementation:
k = 4*ell_2; k_half = k // 2
K.<z> = CyclotomicField(k)
zeta = z^ell_1
alpha = -4*zeta - 4*sum(prod((1+zeta^j)^2 for j in range(1,n+1)) * zeta^(n+1) for n in range(1, k_half))
P = alpha.minpoly()
K_alpha = NumberField(P, 'a')
Gal = K_alpha.galois_closure('b')
deg = Gal.degree()
Omega = (P(ell_1) + P(ell_2))^(ell_2-1) / deg
